listen.script: Hi, I'm Noura. This weekend is going to be busy. On Friday, we're going to visit my grandma in Unaizah. On Saturday, I'm going to stay in and finish my science project.
listen.q: What is Noura going to do on Saturday?

listen.script: A: Omar, would you like to come to the park with us on Thursday? B: Thanks for inviting me, but I'm afraid I can't. I'm going to the dentist after school. A: That's a shame. Maybe next time!
listen.q: Why can't Omar go to the park?

listen.script: Yesterday was a terrible day. I lost my new pen, and then our team lost the basketball match. I was really disappointed. But in the evening, my uncle visited us with a big cake, so I felt better.
listen.q: How did the speaker feel in the evening?

listen.script: Welcome to the pool, everyone. Here are the rules. You must wear a swimming hat. You mustn't run, because the floor is slippery. You don't have to bring a towel, because we have towels for you.
listen.q: What don't swimmers have to bring?

read.passage: Hi, I'm Sam. Next Thursday is a big day for me. Our school is going to have a sports day, and I'm going to run in the 100-metre race. I'm excited, but I'm also a bit nervous because the other runners are very fast. Every student has to wear the school sports T-shirt, and we have to arrive at seven o'clock. We don't have to bring water because the school is going to give everyone a bottle. My best friend Faisal invited me to his house after the race. I'd love to go, but I'm afraid I can't because my grandparents are going to visit us that evening. I really hope I win!

qs.q: What is Sam going to do on sports day?
What don't students have to bring?
Why can't Sam go to Faisal's house?
options: His grandparents are going to visit.
He is going to be at the race.
